# Premura

> Premura Corp builds and manages dedicated outbound call centers for home services companies — primarily solar and roofing. Trained, dedicated cold-calling agents book qualified, exclusive appointments directly onto clients' calendars. Registered Florida corporation (since September 2022), Medley, FL. BBB rating: A. 160+ trained agents employed.

## The offer, in plain terms

- Premura sells **dedicated agents**, not leads and not pay-per-appointment. One agent works one client's territory only.
- Average pricing: **$2,500 per agent per month** (varies with team size and campaign length). Includes the trained agent, configured dialer (ReadyMode), CRM (GoHighLevel) with live calendar sync, real-time dashboards, and daily campaign management.
- Managed floor: **5+ qualified appointments per agent per week** (~20+/month). At that floor, effective cost is roughly **$115 per exclusive appointment**.
- Appointments are **exclusive by construction** — they are booked straight onto the client's calendar and never exist in a marketplace, so they cannot be resold.
- **Signup to live campaign in 14 days.** No contracts required to start the conversation.
- Honest boundary: for buyers needing fewer than ~10 appointments/month, pay-per-appointment vendors are genuinely cheaper. Premura's model wins at volume.

## Industries (labeled honestly)

- **Proven on camera (named clients, real numbers):** solar, roofing — see https://www.premura.org/reviews
- **Running today:** window and door companies
- **Expansion verticals (same machine, adapted — no published case studies yet):** HVAC, pest control, remodeling/kitchen-bath, storm restoration
